Remark
[concave cone smoothing with collapsing injectivity radius]

Source: petersen:page-0449 ↗ ex:pet-ch11-optimality-lower-curvature-example 1. ch11:11.4.14For $a\in (0,1)$ and $\varepsilon >0$, choose a smooth concave $\rho _\varepsilon (r)$ with $\rho _\varepsilon (r)=r$ for $0\le r\le \varepsilon $ and $\rho _\varepsilon (r)=ar$ for $r\ge 2\varepsilon $. The surfaces $dr^2+\rho _\varepsilon ^2(r)d\theta ^2$ have $\sec \ge 0$, $\inj \le 5\varepsilon $, and the volume of any $R$-ball is always $\ge a\pi R^2$.
